title: Mother and Son on Sunny Beach Shoreline, 1950 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A smiling mother standing beside her young son on the wet sand at the water's edge of a sunlit beach. She wears a dark button-front cover-up dress with light lapel detailing, while the boy is barefoot in a white sleeveless undershirt and dark shorts. In the background, another young girl in a swimsuit looks on as gentle waves roll onto the shore. The photo features classic deckled scalloped borders with handwritten annotations on the front margin.
